prompts.glacier: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: actual terrain texture for a vertical scrolling 16-bit pixel-art aircraft arcade game. Create one tall portrait image, 1:3 aspect ratio, ideally 720x2160 pixels. Strict orthographic DIRECTLY OVERHEAD aerial map. No horizon, no perspective, no isometric angle. Sophisticated original 1990s VGA 16-bit game pixel art, small crisp pixel clusters, stepped shadows and selective dithering, NOT painted or blurred. Opaque image fills all edges, no borders, no text, no planes, no bullets, no characters, no interface. Muted low-to-medium contrast so small bright enemy bullets stand out. Keep central third visually calmer, environmental detail concentrated along irregular sides, not a straight corridor. Top and bottom edges both quiet matching textured ground to support vertical looping. An arctic glacier archipelago: dark blue-green channels winding between broken pale blue ice shelves, deep fissures, scattered polygonal ice floes, snowy rocky islands, tiny abandoned research huts and antenna towers. Sparse restrained desaturated ice highlights, no large bright white snow fields. Multiple curved waterways and interesting pockets of frozen terrain. Pale teal, slate navy, muted lavender and subdued ivory.
